run.question:
Alertmanager alert CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh (severity critical) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-17T01:15:54Z.
Alert expression (PromQL): label_replace(label_replace((sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m]))) / (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}[5m]))), "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.*)"), "service", "$1", "service_name", "(.*)") > 0.5
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is real and reproduces: checkout's server-span error ratio for oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder reached 1.0 at the 01:13:54-01:15:54 samples, and the failure is payment's Charge call. Every sampled checkout PlaceOrder error carries otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', and the sibling checkout client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge fails with the same message; payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge reports the same error, thrown inside payment's handler at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37. Payment Charge server spans were 100% STATUS_CODE_ERROR in the final 5 minutes (7.5 error span increase, 0 unset), and the error-span counts match checkout's PlaceOrder and Charge-client counts 1:1, so checkout's errors are propagated from payment rather than independently produced. Payment's only visible outbound dependency, a flagd ResolveFloat client span, carries no error status, and flagd's own resolve operations show no ERROR series, so no infrastructure failure on the flagd path was observed. The checkout Deployment rollout in the window is visible as a config-only replacement (new ReplicaSet checkout-6cf48b76d7 and pod checkout-6cf48b76d7-w7v8n from the 01:05:54 sample, same image digest sha256:5ab0d7b9... as the removed pod checkout-59d79499c4-zj8fl) and is kept as an unproven hypothesis, not the supported cause. Shipping and email spans in the same window show no error status, and the load-generator/frontend-proxy path shows only the propagated HTTP 500s.

claims.text: The alert expression reproduces against the target: the checkout PlaceOrder server-span error ratio (5m rate) was 0 for the 01:05:54-01:10:54 samples and then 0.316 at 01:11:54, 0.491 at 01:12:54 and 1.0 at 01:13:54, 01:14:54 and 01:15:54. The same series shows an earlier episode (1.0 at 00:20:54, declining to 0 by 00:25:54) and no samples between 00:29:54 and 01:11:54.

Sampled checkout server spans for oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder are error spans with otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (service_version 2.0.2).

Inside checkout, the client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge fails with otel.status_description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and rpc.grpc.status_code=2, and its parent is the checkout PlaceOrder span of the same trace (for example checkout span d010a48740b98336 in trace c7734d386b9fc003663ef6171582871e).

The payment service's server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries grpc.error_name Error, grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.stacktrace 'Error: Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) at async Object.chargeServiceHandler [as charge] (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22)', with duration 0.7-1.1 ms; its parent reference points at the checkout client span of the same trace (e.g. parent spanID d010a48740b98336 for payment span e5e526348255aace), giving the checkout -> payment call edge.

Payment Charge server spans were 100% error in the 5 minutes ending 01:16:04: increase over 300s of 7.5 for status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR and 0 for STATUS_CODE_UNSET; payment's internal span 'charge' carries no status tag, and payment's only client span (grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat) is STATUS_CODE_UNSET with no errors.

The payment Charge error onset is visible at 1-minute resolution: the first nonzero ERROR increase appears in the 300s window ending 01:12:04 (4.71), and STATUS_CODE_UNSET charge spans fall to 0 for the windows ending 01:14:04, 01:15:04 and 01:16:04 while ERROR stays at 8.47, 9.40 and 7.5.

Over 01:06:04-01:16:04 the error-span increase is identical (10.356) for payment span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, checkout span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, while frontend/load-generator/frontend-proxy errors are 11.111; no checkout operation other than the payment call and PlaceOrder appears among the checkout error series.

Whole-window increase by status shows the same shape for checkout PlaceOrder and payment Charge: STATUS_CODE_ERROR 7.778 (10-minute window ending 00:25:54), 0 (ending 00:35:54) and 10.023 (ending 01:15:54), i.e. the same payment Charge failure mode already occurred earlier in the window before the checkout rollout and both counters move together.

The failure reaches the customer path: over 01:06:04-01:16:04 load-generator POST error spans increase 11.111 (vs 100 unset), frontend-proxy ingress error spans 11.111 (vs 310 unset) and router frontend egress 11.111 (vs 310 unset); the sampled error spans carry http.status_code 500 (load-generator POST, frontend-proxy ingress/egress, frontend POST and POST /api/checkout).

The checkout Deployment changed during the window: a new ReplicaSet checkout-6cf48b76d7 first appears at the 01:05:54 sample, the old pod checkout-59d79499c4-zj8fl is last present at 01:00:54 and the new pod checkout-6cf48b76d7-w7v8n runs the same image digest ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635, i.e. a configuration-only replacement; checkout ready replicas stayed at 1 throughout.

The payment workload did not change during the window: single pod payment-6f7bc865d6-s8xt4, owner_kind ReplicaSet owner_name payment-6f7bc865d6, whose ReplicaSet is owned by owner_kind Deployment owner_name payment, image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:33f327b357617379bfa3b292f430d1f06e66e2872494125a40bae14d8fe57d87 at every sample 00:15:54-01:15:54, with kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{deployment="payment",namespace="otel-demo"} = 1 throughout.

flagd's own evaluations show no errors in 01:06:04-01:16:04: flagd service spans for ResolveBoolean (7.778), ResolveFloat (1.111), ResolveInt (72.385), flagd.ofrep (36.667), resolveAnyValue (36.667), resolveBoolean (15.556), resolveFloat (2.222), resolveInt (144.77) are all STATUS_CODE_UNSET; the only ERROR series under service_name="flagd" is flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream (1.111), and the same EventStream error count (1.111) appears on ad and recommendation clients, while payment's flagd client span is STATUS_CODE_UNSET (1.036).

The other checkout dependencies that were checked show no error-status spans in 01:06:04-01:16:04: shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote (18.889), oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder (7.778) and POST (18.889), and email POST /send_order_confirmation (7.778) are present only with STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and the aggregate error-span query for that window returned no shipping or email series (STATUS_CODE_UNSET does not by itself prove success).

No flag-configuration sync activity was observed in the sampled windows: increase over 300s of the flagd span flagSync was 0 at the points ending 00:20:54, 00:25:54 and 01:15:54 (other points have no samples), so a flagd flag-file change in the incident window is neither confirmed nor excluded.

Deepest remaining candidate for why payment rejects every charge: the rejection is produced by payment's own charge handler (charge.js:37) and the message names 'Invalid token' together with 'app.loyalty.level=gold', while payment's only outbound call is a flagd ResolveFloat evaluation with no error status, so a flag-driven fault-injection / loyalty-level-gated rejection inside payment is plausible; the actual flag value or its change is not observable in the available data.

The checkout rollout reported at 01:02:04Z (rel-20261117010204) could have changed the charge request content/context (e.g. the token or loyalty level forwarded to payment) and thereby triggered payment's rejections; this remains unproven and is not supported by the observed signals.

Evidence against the checkout rollout being the trigger: the rollout kept the same image digest (configuration-only, so no checkout code change), the error is thrown inside payment's handler at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 while the payment pod/ReplicaSet/image are unchanged for the whole window, checkout's PlaceOrder error ratio stayed 0 for the ~5 minutes the new pod was already serving (samples 01:05:54-01:10:54) before rising at 01:11:54, and the identical payment Charge error count appeared earlier in the window (7.778 error span increase in the 10-minute window ending 00:25:54) before any 01:02:04 rollout.

Evidence against a flagd-side outage as the cause: flagd resolve operations and payment's flagd ResolveFloat client span carry no error status in 01:06:04-01:16:04, and the only flagd ERROR series is the long-lived EventStream span, which also appears with the same count on ad and recommendation clients; flagd serving errors would also have to explain why only payment Charge, and nothing else, fails.

gaps: change_history is not integrated: the content of release rel-20261117010204 (a configuration-only checkout change, same image digest) is unknown, and no change record exists for payment or for flagd's flag configuration around 01:10-01:12.
pod_logs is not integrated: payment's internal reason for treating the charge token as invalid, and which caller supplies 'app.loyalty.level=gold', cannot be read from logs.

The ERROR-labelled trace-metric series for checkout PlaceOrder and payment Charge has no samples between roughly 00:29:54 and 01:11:54, so nothing can be said about that interval; its earlier episode's error message was not sampled.

Only sampled trace views were available (708 checkout spans and 198 payment spans kept, slices read of 14 and 20 rows); the full trace graph, other callers of payment, and spans outside the sampled projection remain unknown.
kubernetes_state is not integrated: no Kubernetes events or ConfigMap/flag-file contents were available to confirm what changed at 01:02:04Z or whether flagd config changed near 01:10.
cart, currency, product-catalog, accounting, quote and image-provider were not individually checked beyond the aggregate error-span query returning no error series for them in 01:06:04-01:16:04.
next_steps: Have a human review the change record / diff for checkout release rel-20261117010204 and check whether it altered anything in the charge request path or user/loyalty context forwarded to payment.

Inspect payment's feature-flag configuration (flagd 'paymentFailure'-style fault flags) and any flag change around 01:10-01:12 that could gate the 'Invalid token' rejection, and confirm the intended value of app.loyalty.level used by the load generator.
Read payment service logs around 01:10-01:16 to confirm the token/card data and the branch taken at charge.js:37, and re-check whether disabling the fault flag restores successful Charge spans.
